from qgis.core import (
    QgsProject, QgsSingleSymbolRenderer,
    QgsSimpleLineSymbolLayer, QgsLineSymbol,
    QgsSymbolLayer
)
from qgis.PyQt.QtGui import QColor

def apply_style_railway(layer):
    """铁路样式：底层黑色0.5mm + 上层白色虚线(间隔3mm, 2mm) 模拟枕木"""
    # 底层符号 - 黑色实线 0.5mm
    bottom_layer = QgsSimpleLineSymbolLayer()
    bottom_layer.setColor(QColor("#000000"))
    bottom_layer.setWidth(0.5)
    bottom_layer.setPenStyle(Qt.SolidLine)
    
    # 上层符号 - 白色虚线(间隔3mm, 2mm)
    top_layer = QgsSimpleLineSymbolLayer()
    top_layer.setColor(QColor("#FFFFFF"))
    top_layer.setWidth(0.5)
    top_layer.setPenStyle(Qt.CustomDashLine)
    top_layer.setCustomDashVector([3.0, 2.0])
    
    symbol = QgsLineSymbol()
    symbol.changeSymbolLayer(0, bottom_layer)
    symbol.appendSymbolLayer(top_layer)
    
    renderer = QgsSingleSymbolRenderer(symbol)
    layer.setRenderer(renderer)
    layer.triggerRepaint()

def apply_style_highway(layer):
    """高速公路样式：底层红色0.8mm + 上层浅红色0.35mm"""
    # 底层 - 红色实线 0.8mm
    bottom_layer = QgsSimpleLineSymbolLayer()
    bottom_layer.setColor(QColor("#FF0000"))
    bottom_layer.setWidth(0.8)
    bottom_layer.setPenStyle(Qt.SolidLine)
    
    # 上层 - 浅红色实线 0.35mm
    top_layer = QgsSimpleLineSymbolLayer()
    top_layer.setColor(QColor("#FF8888"))
    top_layer.setWidth(0.35)
    top_layer.setPenStyle(Qt.SolidLine)
    
    symbol = QgsLineSymbol()
    symbol.changeSymbolLayer(0, bottom_layer)
    symbol.appendSymbolLayer(top_layer)
    
    renderer = QgsSingleSymbolRenderer(symbol)
    layer.setRenderer(renderer)
    layer.triggerRepaint()

def apply_style_national_road(layer):
    """国道样式：橙色实线 0.5mm"""
    layer_style = QgsSimpleLineSymbolLayer()
    layer_style.setColor(QColor("#FF8C00"))
    layer_style.setWidth(0.5)
    layer_style.setPenStyle(Qt.SolidLine)
    
    symbol = QgsLineSymbol()
    symbol.changeSymbolLayer(0, layer_style)
    
    renderer = QgsSingleSymbolRenderer(symbol)
    layer.setRenderer(renderer)
    layer.triggerRepaint()

def apply_style_province_boundary(layer):
    """省界样式：棕色点划线，pattern [5, 2, 0.5, 2]，线宽0.4mm"""
    layer_style = QgsSimpleLineSymbolLayer()
    layer_style.setColor(QColor("#8B4513"))
    layer_style.setWidth(0.4)
    layer_style.setPenStyle(Qt.CustomDashLine)
    layer_style.setCustomDashVector([5.0, 2.0, 0.5, 2.0])
    
    symbol = QgsLineSymbol()
    symbol.changeSymbolLayer(0, layer_style)
    
    renderer = QgsSingleSymbolRenderer(symbol)
    layer.setRenderer(renderer)
    layer.triggerRepaint()

def apply_style_river(layer):
    """河流样式：浅蓝色实线 0.4mm"""
    layer_style = QgsSimpleLineSymbolLayer()
    layer_style.setColor(QColor("#87CEEB"))
    layer_style.setWidth(0.4)

    symbol = QgsLineSymbol()
    symbol.changeSymbolLayer(0, layer_style)
    
    renderer = QgsSingleSymbolRenderer(symbol)
    layer.setRenderer(renderer)
    layer.triggerRepaint()
